data.name: DELIVERY - 4 Passenger (multi-day)
data.headline: 4 Seats • 2-7 Day Rental Options • Must have a valid drivers license
data.description:
#*Golf Cart Rentals Delivered to You*

##Rentals for events, weddings, commerical use, and much more.##

**3 day minimum for all rental deliveries**


##About

- All our vehicles are lithium powered & have a range of 20-30 miles
- 110V outlet required for charging vehicle overnight
- 4 passenger: 2 seats facing forward and 2 seats facing backward 
- Carts are street legal and must stay on street roads at all times unless on private property.
- All carts go up to 25 mph

Please note: No children under 2 years of age are allowed on golf carts.

## Requirements

- All drivers must have a valid drivers license
- Rental contract must be signed prior to delivery 
- 50% deposit taken at time of booking
data.cancellation_notes:
If cancelled **within 24-hours of MAKING** the reservation, you will receive a **FULL REFUND**.
Anytime after the 24 hour period, we offer rebooking to another date within the same calendar year if rescheduled within 5 days of delivery. 

Please note: We do not refund for the following circumstances:
- No accessible outlet to charge cart. Please check with your accommodation prior to booking. 
- Returning Early (our deliveries are pre-scheduled and cannot be changed)
data.booking_notes:
**YOUR BOOKING WILL BE CANCELLED IF WE DO NOT RECEIVE A SIGNED WAIVER. TO CONFIRM YOUR BOOKING, SIGN YOUR WAIVER ASAP. ABSOLUTELY NO DELIVERY WILL BE MADE WITHOUT THE SIGNED WAIVER IN ADVANCE**

Important things to know about our Golf Cart Rentals:

- All drivers must be 18 years old or older, have a valid drivers license and insurance.
- All drivers must sign a rental waiver.
- Golf carts are driven on street roads, all same laws as cars apply. 
- If keeping the cart overnight or multiple nights,  a 110V outlet is required to charge the cart. 

**(No children under the age of 2 allowed)**
